text:
Nina CSM: Heads-up  Sirocco Labs is seeing throttling during their integration lab. They're asking for a short burst window + ingress CIDR/header allowlist so their engineers can complete onboarding tests without errors.
Marco NetOps: Copy. Please post source IPs, which regions to permit, desired start/end times, and whether to auto-revoke. Also which API key will they use?
Nina CSM: IPs: 203.0.113.200/29 (workshop VMs) and 198.51.100.66/32 (CI runners). Regions: us-west2 for the lab, europe-west4 for observers. Window: 2 hours starting 11:00 PT. Auto-revoke: yes. Key: sirocco-lab-11am. Tag metadata: renewal_watch:high and cs_owner:Nina.
Owen AM: This session is tied to their procurement decision in ~3w. If onboarding stalls it's a big risk to renewal. Appreciate fast turn.
Marco NetOps: I can add the CIDRs and apply a temporary throughput lift to that key. ETA ~8m. @Ops Bot can you open an ops ticket for peering & revert scheduling?
Ops Bot: Created ticket CS-10123  temporary throughput lift + ingress allowlist for sirocco-lab-11am. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-10123
Keisha Support: I'll put up a live dashboard and set alerts: 429 > 2% or 5xx > 0.5%. Send me the key name to scope logs.
Nina CSM: Key is sirocco-lab-11am (do not paste the real key). We'll rotate keys after the window. Please capture failing request ids and anonymized payloads.
Luca Eng: Quick mitigation suggestion: route webhook and telemetry hits to a lightweight handler to preserve token budget for interactive flows. Example routing rule to apply at edge:
```
- match: header.x-customer == "sirocco"
  policies:
    - name: lab-burst
      override_rate_limit: 10rps
      regions: [us-west2, europe-west4]
    - name: webhook-fallback
      model: tiny-handler
      when: path startswith "/webhook" or path startswith "/telemetry"
```
Luca Eng: This keeps the interactive lab responsive while bulk jobs hit the cheap handler.
Marco NetOps: Applied CIDR entries and scheduled throughput lift on sirocco-lab-11am. Auto-revoke set for 13:00 PT. Added log tags customer:sirocco session:lab-2026-05-07 renewal_watch:high. Posting peering IP when provisioned.
Keisha Support: Dashboards live and annotated CS-10123. Pager configured for sustained threshold breaches.
Ops Bot: CS-10123 updated with provisional peering IP 35.210.77.142 and scheduled revert job at 13:00 PT.
Owen AM: I'll run the enablement at 11:10 PT and capture quick NPS + verbatim comments. Nina, please collect any error screenshots and rough repro steps.
Nina CSM: Will collect NPS and screenshots. Also request own-team not to share any user emails in the ticket (customer asked). Use pseudonyms only.
Keisha Support: Requesting top-10 failing request ids + anonymized prompts be emailed to cs-evidence@redwood.com so I can attach them to CS-10123.
Luca Eng: If you send the failing prompts, we can run a fast analysis and return quick suggestions: prompt caching, shorter prefixes, or pre-warming KV cache for repeated prefixes.
Marco NetOps: All changes applied. Monitoring now. Will revert automatically at 13:00 PT.
Nina CSM: Checklist: [x] CIDRs added, [x] throughput lift scheduled, [x] dashboards + alerts, [x] ticket CS-10123, [x] peering IP posted, [ ] post-lab NPS + error samples.
Owen AM: Fingers crossed  landing this will help move renewal from at-risk -> on-track. I'll post the outcome and NPS in-thread after the session.
Nina CSM: Thanks everyone  I'll close the loop after the lab and include any prompt-level patterns for engineering review. :thumbsup:
